1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000020_ZORAALJA
1.description: You've been consorting with Wuk Lamat.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000030_ZORAALJA
2.description: No matter. I do not know what you are scheming...

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000040_ZORAALJA
3.description: But when your realm lay on the brink, you were powerless. You had no choice but to turn to me.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000050_ZORAALJA
4.description: Whatever sentiment you may feel for her, it is my power you require. Is it not?

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000060_SPHENE
5.description: Perhaps... And yet, knowing the love that Wuk Lamat bears for her people─how she regards them all as kin...

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000070_SPHENE
6.description: I cannot help but wish to spare her the same pain I have suffered.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000080_SPHENE
7.description: What's more, her friends possess new knowledge. Were we to work together, we might find another path.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000090_SPHENE
8.description: I know you're loath to consider it, but...is there no hope for peace with Tuliyollal?

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000100_SPHENE
9.description: What we've already done may be unforgivable, but it needn't continue. You needn't kill your brother and sister.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000110_ZORAALJA
10.description: Hmph. I slew my only flesh and blood. Yet you attempt to sway me with an appeal to family?

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000120_ZORAALJA
11.description: The memory of my father's final moments still fills me with disappointment. Age came for him before I did.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000121_ZORAALJA
12.description: For long years I sought to prove the miracle. And weak as he was, defeating him achieved nothing.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000130_ZORAALJA
13.description: To kill them is my only recourse...

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000131_ZORAALJA
14.description: Wuk Lamat and Koana, who bested him as he was in his prime!

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000140_SPHENE
15.description: They are still your siblings, even if not by blood. That such bonds should mean so little to you...

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000150_ZORAALJA
16.description: I am bound to no one─serve none save myself. I made that clear when first you spoke to me in the golden city.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000160_ZORAALJA
17.description: Remember: I can easily kill your beloved “family.” If you would protect them, cast aside any foolish notions.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000170_ZORAALJA
18.description: Your wisdom and abilities are valuable insofar as our goals align. So think well before you act, Queen of Reason.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000190_ZORAALJA
20.description: Wuk Lamat. If you are Father's worthy successor, then you will find your way to me.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000200_ZORAALJA
21.description: But should you fall short, I <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> lay waste to Tuliyollal.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000220_ERENVILLE
23.description: Everkeep, a tower of electrope piercing a perpetual shroud of storm clouds.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000230_ERENVILLE
24.description: Occupying the ninth level of this twelve-tiered structure is a residential district called Solution Nine.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000240_ERENVILLE
25.description: In so naming their home, what hopes did its founders harbor for it? And did it prove the answer they sought?

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000260_CAHCIUA
27.description: There are more districts throughout the tower, including industrial ones, but Solution Nine is the largest.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000270_WUKLAMAT
28.description: Just being here makes my head spin...

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000290_CAHCIUA
30.description: A city of shimmering electrope, replete with strange technologies that cater to every conceivable need. We never dreamed of the like back home in Tuliyollal.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000300_CAHCIUA
31.description: Now, while I go and explain the situation to those in the Backroom, why not take a moment to explore?

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000310_CAHCIUA
32.description: I believe lived experiences are far more educational than dry explanations.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000320_CAHCIUA
33.description: And you want to know more about Sphene and Zoraal Ja's dominion, do you not?

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
36.description: We do need to better understand who and what we're dealing with here.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000330_WUKLAMAT
37.description: Heh, I had a feeling you'd be keen.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000340_WUKLAMAT
38.description: It's no less than our duty.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000350_GRAHATIA
39.description: Just to confirm─while we have been allowed inside, are we also permitted to roam?

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000360_CAHCIUA
40.description: Absolutely. As Sphene's registered guests, you'll find you're exempt from the sentries' scrutiny.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000370_CAHCIUA
41.description: Ah─the elevator to the uppermost level. I wouldn't go near <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103>, but other areas should be fine provided you act like you belong.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000380_ALISAIE
42.description: Alright, then. We'll show ourselves around.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000390_GRAHATIA
43.description: Yes. Familiarizing ourselves with the technology here will help us prepare for the battles to come.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000400_KRILE
44.description: Try not to enjoy yourselves too much, or you're liable to attract attention.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000410_CAHCIUA
45.description: Once you've explored to your satisfaction, come to the entrance to True Vue in the eastern sector.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000420_CAHCIUA
46.description: The way from there is a little complicated, so I'll send someone to guide you.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000440_KRILE
48.description: I shall speak with the residents. Perhaps one of them will recognize the earring.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000450_WUKLAMAT
49.description: What's with this place? How can this all be the inside of a tower?

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000460_ERENVILLE
50.description: ...So, what aren't you telling me? Where are you?

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000470_CAHCIUA
51.description: That, I can't reveal yet─precautions, you understand. Just know that I'm safe.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000490_CAHCIUA
53.description: But come, tell me about your adventurer friend. You seem to have a great deal of faith in <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000500_CAHCIUA
54.description: You must have been through a lot together.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000510_ERENVILLE
55.description: You might say that. For instance, we found the entrance to the golden city.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000530_CAHCIUA
57.description: Elene'shpya! Why didn't you mention this sooner!?

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000540_WUKLAMAT
58.description: Um... You want to explore together?

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000550_WUKLAMAT
59.description: It's not that I'm scared or anything... Everything is just so different from home, is all!

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000580_SPHENE
62.description: I was worried you might have had trouble at the checkpoint, but I see everything went according to plan.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000600_SPHENE
64.description: Now, I know you've scarcely arrived...but I have a request to make of you.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000630_SPHENE
67.description: I'll say it plain. I want you to make peace with Zoraal Ja.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000640_WUKLAMAT
68.description: What? I thought you said you weren't on his side.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000650_SPHENE
69.description: We have come no closer to seeing eye to eye. Nor do I condone his methods.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000660_SPHENE
70.description: Be that as it may, I don't want you to fight him. I don't want you to regret a decision made in anger and haste.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000670_SPHENE
71.description: Unequipped with regulators as you are, the risk is too great.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000680_WUKLAMAT
72.description: I appreciate your concern, but you ask the impossible.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000690_WUKLAMAT
73.description: Zoraal Ja murdered our father. His minions slaughtered our countrymen. He will never renounce his war. As Vow of Resolve, it falls to me to stop him.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000700_WUKLAMAT
74.description: I know you love your people too, and so you must understand how I feel. Why I cannot─will not─back down.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000710_SPHENE
75.description: I do understand. All too well...

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000711_SPHENE
76.description: Let me say only this, then.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000720_SPHENE
77.description: Zoraal Ja will use any means to win. If you would protect your people, return to them at once and prepare. Prepare as best you can.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000730_SPHENE
78.description: It may ring hollow, coming from the queen of an enemy nation...

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000740_SPHENE
79.description: But unlike me, you still have the power to determine your own fate.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000750_WUKLAMAT
80.description: You really are a curious one.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000760_WUKLAMAT
81.description: Look, you needn't worry for us. We have dependable comrades holding the fort in Tuliyollal.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000770_WUKLAMAT
82.description: They'll keep everyone safe, so we can devote our attention to affairs here.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
85.description: Never fear─I'll be there alongside her.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
86.description: I won't yield on this either.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000790_SPHENE
87.description: So you have comrades on whom you can rely...

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000810_WUKLAMAT
89.description: You know, we'd like to learn more about you.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000830_WUKLAMAT
91.description: To be frank, we're still not sure whether or not you're trustworthy.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000840_WUKLAMAT
92.description: So if you have a moment, would you show us around the district? That way, we can get to know you better.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000850_SPHENE
93.description: Hehehe... You're asking me─the queen─to “show you around”?

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000860_SPHENE
94.description: Oh, but I jest. I'm flattered that you've taken an interest in me.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000870_SPHENE
95.description: Very well, I shall be your guide. You're my guests, after all, and teaching you about my realm would be a pleasure in and of itself.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000880_SPHENE
96.description: If you like, I can introduce you to my citizens, too. I consider them family, as you do yours.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000890_WUKLAMAT
97.description: By all means! We're in your capable hands.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000900_SPHENE
98.description: That you are. This will be an enjoyable and enlightening tour, I promise!

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000930_SPHENE
101.description: An infusion station. It dispenses souls in exchange for credits.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000940_SPHENE
102.description: Through hard work, citizens can obtain the peace of mind provided by spare souls. It's the way of life for Alexandrians and has been for quite some time.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000950_SPHENE
103.description: But I imagine it must be difficult for outsiders to comprehend.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000960_WUKLAMAT
104.description: That's putting it lightly. To be honest, it sounds disturbing.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000970_WUKLAMAT
105.description: Still, I won't dismiss it out of hand. Practices like these don't arise from nothing.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000980_WUKLAMAT
106.description: There's a reason why your culture is the way it is, and I'd like to understand. Won't you tell us some of your realm's history?

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_000990_SPHENE
110.description: Very well. Be warned, though, that it may take a while.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001000_SPHENE
111.description: In the distant past─over a thousand years ago, it's said─lightning energy began to swell in our world.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001010_SPHENE
112.description: According to ancient records that date back around eight centuries, the rainy season spanned a quarter of the year, during which time severe thunderstorms ravaged the land.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001020_SPHENE
113.description: Four centuries later, this season had lengthened to nearly half the year.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001030_SPHENE
114.description: The trend continued, with our ancestors spending longer and longer languishing beneath storm clouds. Crops failed and livestock starved.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001040_SPHENE
115.description: But amidst this growing desperation, a miraculous material was discovered that promised salvation: electrope.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001050_WUKLAMAT
116.description: The stuff that's used everywhere here.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001060_SPHENE
117.description: Indeed. One day, when out inspecting a forest after lightning had caused a fire, a villager came upon a curious black ore none had seen before.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001070_SPHENE
118.description: Testing revealed that the ore possessed a singular property: it could store lightning and convert it to other energies. In that instant, the scourge of endless storms became a blessing.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001080_SPHENE
119.description: Dubbed electrope, the ore found use in myriad inventions and dramatically improved people's lives.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001090_SPHENE
120.description: So much so, in fact, that all nations soon became dependent upon it─despite the difficulty of obtaining it in quantity.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001100_SPHENE
121.description: Supply was chronically scarce. And when nations couldn't meet their needs with their own deposits, some resorted to taking electrope from others...

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001110_SPHENE
122.description: Fighting was isolated and sporadic─until electrope came to be used in warfare. First in the weaponry of invaders, then in the countermeasures of defenders, and then in every aspect of combat where an advantage might be had.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001120_SPHENE
123.description: This served only to exacerbate the ore shortage, leading to further escalation. Before long, the entire world was engulfed in a terrible war known as the Storm Surge.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001130_SPHENE
124.description: As the war came to a head, Alexandria's neighbor Lindblum committed its stores of electrope to the production of a weapon of mass destruction.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001140_SPHENE
125.description: They deployed it on the front lines...and triggered a calamity of frightful magnitude. Not even their own scientists had anticipated the force of the lightning that was unleashed. The energy inundated the entire continent, laying it to waste.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001150_WUKLAMAT
126.description: So that's how your world came to be this way...

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
128.description: I'm put in mind of the Flood of Light...

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
129.description: Just like the Flood of Darkness...

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A3_000_003_NONE_VOICE
130.description: Sounds an awful lot like an Umbral Calamity...

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001160_SPHENE
131.description: You truly know a great many things that I don't. I should like to learn about you too sometime.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001170_SPHENE
132.description: But to continue the tale... The people of Alexandria had already lost much to the war. They lost almost everything else to the levin.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001180_SPHENE
133.description: Those who survived bore deep scars, tormented by the memory of loved ones taken too soon. Though they yet lived, the cruel specter of death was with them always.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001190_SPHENE
134.description: Seeking a solution, our scientists turned once more to electrope. And after extensive research, they developed the means to preserve memory and soul.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001200_SPHENE
135.description: Physical death isn't the end. So long as our memories endure, we may live on...

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001210_SPHENE
136.description: This belief sustained us then, and it sustains us now, granting us comfort.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001230_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
138.description: Your Majesty! Help me, I beg you! Help me!

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001250_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
140.description: I've got no souls left─not a single one─but the lot at Soul Supply refuse to give me any!

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001280_FACILITATORMALE
143.description: My apologies, Your Majesty! This man, he does no work. Instead he drinks his days away on True Vue.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001290_FACILITATORMALE
144.description: He has only himself to blame if he has no credits for souls.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001300_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
145.description: That's not true! I'm a fighter at the Arcadion─or rather, I was!

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001310_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
146.description: I haven't been allowed to fight because of the king's decree! It isn't my choice!

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001320_SPHENE
147.description: I see, you're a brave warrior of the arena.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001330_SPHENE
148.description: I want to help you, I sincerely do, but I cannot give you preferential treatment.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001340_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
149.description: Then open up the Arcadion again so I can fight!

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001350_SPHENE
150.description: I'm sorry, but that's not my decision to make. The king requires feral souls for war. He doesn't wish for them to be expended on amusements.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001360_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
151.description: You're useless! A queen in naught but name!

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001370_FACILITATORMALE
153.description: Insolent wretch! How dare you take that tone with Her Majesty!

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001380_SPHENE
154.description: It's quite alright. Such things don't bother me, nor do I think ill of this man.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001390_SPHENE
155.description: Hear me. Though I cannot grant you a soul, I mean it when I say I want you to live.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001400_SPHENE
156.description: I love all of you equally. Dearly. You are as family to me, and it pains me to see you deny yourself hope.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001410_SPHENE
157.description: I want you to find a happiness all your own, even if you must grow it from the smallest seed of joy. Out there, somewhere, is a reason for you to smile again.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001420_SPHENE
158.description: We all need to vent our frustrations from time to time. I will always be willing to lend an ear.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001440_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
160.description: Even without a spare soul, I suppose I'm fine as long as I stay in Solution Nine.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001450_SOLUTIONNFIGHTER
161.description: I apologize for my rudeness. Good day to you.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001460_SPHENE
162.description: Keep your chin up, my friend! And when you feel better, I'm sure you'll find another way to apply your talents.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001470_SPHENE
163.description: Ahaha... I'm sorry you had to see that. Let's keep moving, shall we?

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001480_SPHENE
164.description: Right─I believe we've visited all the main facilities. With that, I declare our tour concluded!

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001490_WUKLAMAT
165.description: That man from before... Does that sort of thing happen often?

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001500_SPHENE
166.description: Somewhat. It's unavoidable. Hardships are a fact of life.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001510_SPHENE
167.description: Our soul management system has sustained our realm for generations, but it isn't without flaws.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001520_SPHENE
168.description: For one, people have become accustomed to having spare souls. Without them they feel vulnerable and anxious. Some claim it may also have contributed to a decline in births.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001530_WUKLAMAT
169.description: Just thinking out loud, but would it be possible to do away with the system?

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001550_WUKLAMAT
171.description: I know it isn't easy to change one's beliefs and way of life. The Mamool Ja had their reasons for their reliance on blessed siblings, much as you have yours for souls.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001560_WUKLAMAT
172.description: But if we defeated Zoraal Ja, you'd be able to make all the decisions, right?

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001570_WUKLAMAT
173.description: Then we could work together to fix things. Restore your realm to where it belongs, and see where we can go from there.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001580_SPHENE
174.description: Listen to me. There's something that I need to tell you...

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001600_SPHENE
176.description: A-Actually, never mind. It's nothing of import.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001610_SPHENE
177.description: Well, it was lovely showing you around.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001630_WUKLAMAT
179.description: Thanks so much for the tour. We've learned not only about your realm, but you as well.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001640_WUKLAMAT
180.description: For now, our priority is Zoraal Ja.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001641_WUKLAMAT
181.description: But once we've dealt with him, perhaps I can return the favor and show you Tuliyollal.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001660_SPHENE
183.description: It seems I've no choice but to continue down this path...

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001670_SPHENE
184.description: Forgive me, Vow Wuk Lamat, but I must disappoint you.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001710_CAHCIUA
188.description: I bid you welcome to the Backroom, Oblivion's humble headquarters.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001720_ALISAIE
189.description: A hideout tucked behind a drinking hole... Brings back memories, doesn't it?

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001730_CAHCIUA
190.description: Our members here are mainly creators and adapters─that is, scientists and engineers who specialize in electrope.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001740_CAHCIUA
191.description: They use their skills to provide support to our field operatives.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001750_CAHCIUA
192.description: Genolt, Shale─be so kind as to give our friends an overview of your duties.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001760_GENOLT
193.description: Well, there's provisionin'. Got to have supplies to fight the good fight, ain't ya? Luckily, we've got the tools to craft most of what we need.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001770_SHALE
194.description: Gathering intelligence is another vital aspect of our work. Everkeep's core system is a veritable treasure trove of information. You just need to know how to get in and find it.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001780_SHALE
195.description: We also handle surveillance and communications─watching the enemy's movements and coordinating our own, that sort of thing.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001790_CAHCIUA
196.description: And among all our activities, we spend a fair bit of effort investigating Preservation.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001800_CAHCIUA
197.description: The organization credited with laying the foundations of electrope technology.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001810_CAHCIUA
198.description: From the soul management system to Everkeep's design, they're behind just about everything you see here. It'd be no exaggeration to say they made this realm what it is.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001820_CAHCIUA
199.description: But their magnum opus was without a doubt the power which was used to join Alexandria to Tural: interdimensional fusion.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001830_GRAHATIA
200.description: Said power isn't unlike my summoning technique and the magick within Azem's crystal.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001840_GRAHATIA
201.description: Yet though the effect is localized, to be able to <hex:021A020203>fuse<hex:021A020103> realities... Even with my knowledge, I struggle to conceive how it could be possible!

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001850_CAHCIUA
202.description: Incidentally, the founders of our group─a husband and wife─were members of Preservation at one point.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001860_CAHCIUA
203.description: But they opposed the fusing of worlds, and so defected in order to prevent it.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001870_KRILE
204.description: While not entirely unexpected given what we have seen, this is still quite the revelation...

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001880_SHALE
205.description: By the by, that's an interesting earring you have there. A novel way of carrying a data storage device.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001900_SHALE
207.description: As a precautionary measure against machine infiltration, we scan everyone as they enter. And when we scanned you, we detected a small quantity of electrope.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001910_SHALE
208.description: Though it's been dressed up, that earring is a storage device, and no mistake. Bought it from a shop here, did you?

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001930_SHALE
210.description: So these people sent you through the portal along with the earring...

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001940_KRILE
211.description: Do you know aught of them?

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001950_CAHCIUA
212.description: Listen, Krile. The husband and wife who founded our order...

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001960_CAHCIUA
213.description: It's believed that they were Milalla.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001970_CAHCIUA
214.description: Though we have no evidence at present, we can't rule out the possibility that they were your parents, or perhaps close relations.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001980_CAHCIUA
215.description: This I posit because they were the very individuals who spearheaded the research into interdimensional fusion. As traitors to Preservation, they were relentlessly pursued.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_001990_CAHCIUA
216.description: If they had a child they feared they couldn't keep safe, entrusting her to the people of another world might've been their best option.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002010_KRILE
218.description: Tell me everything you know about them! No matter how small or seemingly insignificant─anything and everything!

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002020_CAHCIUA
219.description: We don't even know their names, I'm afraid. In a bid to elude Preservation's agents, we suspect they erased all trace of themselves.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002030_CAHCIUA
220.description: I'm sorry we couldn't be of more help. If you're interested, though, you're welcome to review our accumulated data.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002040_KRILE
221.description: Yes, please! As an individual and member of my order both, I wish to learn as much as possible.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002050_GRAHATIA
222.description: I should also like to peruse the data. Where the joining of realities is concerned, I may well be of service.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002060_CAHCIUA
223.description: Of course. Feel free to peruse to your heart's content.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002080_SHALE
225.description: If you like, I can examine your earring. I have to say, the prospect that it belonged to our founders has me itching to take a look.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002090_ALISAIE
226.description: I daresay we have enough eyes to pore over your records. Is there any other way we might be productive?

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002100_CAHCIUA
227.description: Hmmm... Not right now. We're still waiting for Zoraal Ja to make the next move.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002110_WUKLAMAT
228.description: In that case, Alisaie, would you mind accompanying me?

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002140_SHALE
232.description: <sigh> Never a moment's peace... Pay him no mind. I don't.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002150_GENOLT
233.description: Oi, you two there. One o' ye give me a hand, would ye? Don't matter who.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002160_ERENVILLE
234.description: ...I just remembered I have matters to discuss with Shale.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002170_WUKLAMAT
236.description: I've been meaning to ask about that Mamool Ja child. Could he be...?

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002180_CAHCIUA
237.description: Yes. In all likelihood, he's Zoraal Ja's son.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002200_WUKLAMAT
239.description: But what is he doing here?

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002210_CAHCIUA
240.description: He was abandoned, the poor dear. We found him in the driftdowns a few years ago.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002220_WUKLAMAT
241.description: To think he'd cast aside his child...

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002230_CAHCIUA
242.description: We can't say for certain who he was born to or why he was on his own. But he's a blue-scaled Hoobigo, and Zoraal Ja is the only other one around.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002240_CAHCIUA
243.description: That being the case, everyone assumes they're father and son. Even the boy has put two and two together.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002250_CAHCIUA
244.description: This all happened when he was very little, so he has no recollection of his parents. It breaks my heart to think of it...

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002280_CAHCIUA
247.description: It was my hope that he'd grow up to be a man of principle, like his grandfather.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002300_CAHCIUA
250.description: Ah, I should mention that the boy is a little unusual.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002310_CAHCIUA
251.description: At first, I intended to raise him as my own. But just when I thought he was warming to me, he suddenly disappeared.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002320_CAHCIUA
252.description: We searched high and low for several days, and where should he turn up but in the wilds near Everkeep.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002330_ERENVILLE
253.description: What? It's a miracle he didn't fall prey to fiends!

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002340_CAHCIUA
254.description: See, that's another unusual thing. Creatures don't seem to attack him. He could pick his way through the Thunderyards as if he were on a stroll.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002350_CAHCIUA
255.description: On making inquiries, we learned that he had been living alone and receiving food from the people of the outskirts.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002360_CAHCIUA
256.description: This became something of a pattern. We'd track him down and bring him back, only for him to disappear again within a matter of days.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002370_CAHCIUA
257.description: He would return to the wilds, without fail, and once again rely on the kindness of strangers to survive.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002380_CAHCIUA
258.description: Finally, I took the hint and left him be, giving him the solitude he prefers and lending a hand only when he explicitly asks.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002390_WUKLAMAT
259.description: If Gulool Ja is Zoraal Ja's child, that makes him my nephew.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002400_WUKLAMAT
260.description: Assuming he's willing, I'd be glad to take him in like Papa did for me.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002401_WUKLAMAT
261.description: But seeing as I'm here to kill his father, I don't know if it would be right...

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002430_WUKLAMAT
264.description: Don't tell me he heard everything!?

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002440_CAHCIUA
265.description: This is my fault. I asked that he be kept away, but I should've taken more precautions...

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002450_WUKLAMAT
266.description: I'm going after him. I need to explain!

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002460_ALISAIE
267.description: Wait, Lamaty'i. I understand your haste, but it'd be best to coordinate a search.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002470_ALISAIE
268.description: Cahciua, do you have any idea where he might go?

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002480_CAHCIUA
269.description: There's no telling, I'm afraid. He could as easily be outside the tower as here in Solution Nine.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002490_ERENVILLE
270.description: If those who can fight would search below, my mother and I will scour the district.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002500_WUKLAMAT
271.description: Sounds like a plan! Let's get to it!

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002510_WUKLAMAT
272.description: He's come a long way on such short legs. It's a relief he didn't get hurt.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002530_ALISAIE
274.description: So he's looking after those little ones.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002590_OTIS
280.description: (-Rusty Mechanical Soldier-)You know the boy? Who are you and what do you want?

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002600_WUKLAMAT
281.description: My name is Wuk Lamat, and I've come to talk to Gulool Ja.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002620_WUKLAMAT
283.description: I'm sorry if I scared you. I want to get to know you better. That's all.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002630_OTIS
284.description: (-Rusty Mechanical Soldier-)And you, my boy? Do you wish to speak with them?

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002640_GULOOLJA
285.description: I heard them talking... She said she's going to kill my father...

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002650_OTIS
286.description: (-Rusty Mechanical Soldier-)Villains! I will deal with them forthwith!

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002670_GULOOLJA
288.description: I...I want to get to know her too.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002680_OTIS
289.description: (-Rusty Mechanical Soldier-)I see. If that is your desire, then I shall stand aside.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002690_WUKLAMAT
290.description: Alright, then! Let's talk, you and I─lots!

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002700_WUKLAMAT
291.description: But, uh...who's the ancient-looking and...articulate machine?

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002710_OTIS
292.description: (-Rusty Mechanical Soldier-)If I look ancient, it is because I am. This has been my vessel for no less than three hundred and eighty years.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002730_GULOOLJA
294.description: Otis is my friend. When I was hungry and sad, he came and looked after me.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002740_GULOOLJA
295.description: He cooks for me, and teaches me all kinds of things.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002750_GULOOLJA
296.description: Like how to read and write and...and not be noticed by dangerous creatures.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002770_WUKLAMAT
298.description: And teaches you about fiends... What is he exactly?

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002780_OTIS
299.description: (-Rusty Mechanical Soldier-)Ah, how remiss of me. I had neglected to introduce myself.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002790_OTIS
300.description: Ser Otis Velona, lord captain of the royal knights of Alexandria, at your service.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
303.description: You've been functioning for nearly four hundred years?

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
304.description: You seem different from other machines. What's your story?

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002811_OTIS
306.description: And there I thought it was Gulool Ja with whom you wished to speak. Not that I'm averse to taking a walk down memory lane...

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002820_OTIS
307.description: But ere I regale you: we must take our repast!

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002830_WUKLAMAT
308.description: A meal? Here? I hate to turn down food, but I'd prefer to have this conversation in the Backroom...

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002850_WUKLAMAT
310.description: Alright, alright! A repast it is!

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002860_ALISAIE
311.description: She's going to spoil her nephew silly. I'll send word to Erenville so the others can stop worrying.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002870_OTIS
312.description: Now, if I might prevail upon your assistance, I shall whip up my most delectable specialty!

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002890_NAAHE
314.description: Good gods, Elene'shpya!? It's been too long, my friend!

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002900_NAAHE
315.description: Where have you been all these years? What have you been doing with yourself?

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002910_NAAHE
316.description: Hold on... They say Queen Sphene has guests from outside the barrier. That's you, I gather?

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002920_ERENVILLE
317.description: It seems so. I'm looking for my mother─do you know where she is?

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002940_NAAHE
319.description: Sorry, but what was she like again?

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002950_ERENVILLE
320.description: What? It's Cahciua. You know, the one who was too adventurous by half. Who journeyed with the Dawnservant.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002960_NAAHE
321.description: Hmmm... It's not ringing any bells.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002970_ERENVILLE
322.description: You can't be serious. Ours was a tiny little village. Surely you remember her!

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002980_NAAHE
323.description: I really don't... It's all a blank...

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_002990_ERENVILLE
324.description: Is anyone else here from the village?

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003030_ERENVILLE
329.description: I'm looking for Cahciua! Where is she?

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003040_ECAATE
330.description: Wh-What's this all of a sudden? Who's Cahciua?

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003060_ERENVILLE
332.description: The memories of the departed...are taken away...

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003080_CAHCIUA
334.description: (-Cahciua-)Elene'shpya, where are you? The others will be here soon, so hurry back, won't you?

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003090_CAHCIUA
335.description: (-Cahciua-)Do you hear me? Say something, would you?

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003100_WUKLAMAT
336.description: Why don't you come with us? You might get to see Sphene.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003110_OTIS
337.description: Ah. 'Tis a magnanimous and much appreciated offer, but I must decline.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003120_OTIS
338.description: A part of me longs for an audience with Her Majesty, it is true. Yet though it be in my previous life, I failed to protect my queen.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003130_OTIS
339.description: I couldn't bear to show my face before her...and such an uncomely one besides!

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003140_WUKLAMAT
341.description: Alright. If that's how you feel, we won't force you.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003150_WUKLAMAT
342.description: But rest assured we'll visit with Gulool Ja, and we hope you'll cook for us again.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003160_OTIS
343.description: 'Twould be my pleasure. You are welcome to bring other comrades, should you so desire. The more the merrier!

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003170_NOSTALGIA
344.description: (-???-)I've been looking all over for you!

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003180_ALISAIE
345.description: Nostalgia, was it? What's the matter?

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003200_NOSTALGIA
347.description: It's Zoraal Ja! He marches to Vanguard!

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003210_WUKLAMAT
348.description: So he's done waiting... But why weren't we alerted sooner?

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003220_NOSTALGIA
349.description: Our transmissions are being jammed. The lookouts couldn't get through to us.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003230_NOSTALGIA
350.description: Wayakkwe is at Vanguard too, but I can't reach her... Oh, what are we to do?

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003240_WUKLAMAT
351.description: Stay calm. Cahciua has yet to be alerted, yes? Take word to the Backroom as fast as you can.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003250_ALISAIE
352.description: Our linkpearls may still work. I'll try contacting those in Tuliyollal.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003260_WUKLAMAT
353.description: Otis─I need you to keep Gulool Ja safe.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003280_GULOOLJA
355.description: I want to go with you!

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003290_WUKLAMAT
356.description: Absolutely not. A battle's no place for you.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003300_OTIS
357.description: Gulool Ja, the people of the outskirts must be evacuated. For this crucial task, I require your assistance.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003310_OTIS
358.description: Remember: when battle is at hand, anything can happen. Caution is as valuable as any blade.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003330_ALISAIE
360.description: I managed to get hold of Alphinaud. He'll inform Koana.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003340_WUKLAMAT
361.description: Good. How's the situation in Tuliyollal?

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003350_ALISAIE
362.description: There's nothing to worry about...or so my brother assured me. With such short notice, though, I doubt they'll be fully prepared.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003360_WUKLAMAT
363.description: They'll be ready, I'm sure of it. The Vow of Reason is not to be underestimated.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003370_WUKLAMAT
364.description: I'm coming, Zoraal Ja...and we will finish this once and for all!

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003400_ZORAALJA
367.description: You disappoint me, Wuk Lamat. We are foes, yet you had my admiration for defeating Father and claiming the throne.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003410_ZORAALJA
368.description: But instead of coming for me, you gallivant with the resistance. Do I intimidate you?

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003420_WUKLAMAT
369.description: I am here, Brother. I did not run, nor hide. I have come to kill you.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003430_WUKLAMAT
370.description: Let her go. Your quarrel is with me.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003440_ZORAALJA
371.description: And will you settle it one-on-one? Or call upon all and sundry yet again?

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003450_ZORAALJA
372.description: Not that it would make any difference.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003460_WUKLAMAT
373.description: No. Like Papa did, I'll face you alone.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003470_ZORAALJA
374.description: Really? You believe you stand a chance? Have you forgotten how it ended for Father?

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003480_WUKLAMAT
375.description: I remember you couldn't win without relying on other people's souls. Alone I may be weak, but so are you!

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003490_ZORAALJA
376.description: So be it. Do not regret your decision.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003520_WAYAKKWE
379.description: I thought I was done for...

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003540_ZORAALJA
383.description: Had you let her die, you could have dealt me a telling blow. Your compassion will be the end of you.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003550_WUKLAMAT
384.description: I'm not letting anyone else die!

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003570_ZORAALJA
386.description: But I have. With these very hands I slew him.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003580_WUKLAMAT
387.description: His body may be gone, but his spirit lives on in us!

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003590_ZORAALJA
388.description: The Yok Huy's delusion is catching, I see.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003600_WUKLAMAT
389.description: It's no delusion. Papa's love for Tuliyollal gives me strength even now!

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003610_WUKLAMAT
391.description: Come─let's get this over with! For my people and Sphene's!

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003620_ZORAALJA
392.description: How gullible you are. All of this is Sphene's doing.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003630_ZORAALJA
393.description: Her objective is to harvest all life outside the barrier. Our interests happened to align, hence our alliance.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003640_WUKLAMAT
394.description: Liar! Sphene would never do that!

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003650_SPHENE
395.description: The King of Resolve speaks the truth.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003670_SPHENE
397.description: The attack on Tural was no less my desire than Zoraal Ja's.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003680_WUKLAMAT
398.description: You said you wanted none of this. It was a farce from the very start!

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003700_WUKLAMAT
400.description: So it was all just a lie, then? What you said about loving your people as family, about wanting to see them smile...

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003720_SPHENE
402.description: For what it's worth, I'm sorry I deceived you. But I had no choice.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003740_SPHENE
404.description: If I'm to save my people, I must take the lives of yours!

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003750_ZORAALJA
405.description: Behold, Wuk Lamat! The benevolent Queen Sphene.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003760_ZORAALJA
407.description: An illusion that orchestrated a massacre.

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003770_WUKLAMAT
408.description: Endless or machine, or whatever you are now, you bear the memories of the person you once were! You should still have a heart!

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003780_WUKLAMAT
409.description: When you speak of slaughtering my people, do you feel nothing?

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003790_SPHENE
410.description: <hex:021A020203>Nothing<hex:021A020103> is dearer to me than my people. It matters not whether they are living or Endless.

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003800_SPHENE
411.description: As queen, I will do anything to protect them!

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003810_SPHENE
412.description: If it were you, could you have found another way? With your strength, could you have held fast to that which is dear without sacrifice?

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003820_ALISAIE
413.description: What exactly do you seek to do? What are you protecting your people from?

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003830_ZORAALJA
414.description: You waste your words. There is no turning back.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003840_ZORAALJA
417.description: Is this the strength that the love of Tuliyollal lends you?

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003850_ZORAALJA
418.description: A weak ruler walks a path of ruin. Tell me─which of us is worthy of their throne?

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003860_WUKLAMAT
419.description: I already know...it will <hex:021A020203>never<hex:021A020103> be you!

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003870_WUKLAMAT
420.description: As long as you think only of yourself, you'll never be worthy! You'll never surpass Father─or me!

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003890_WUKLAMAT
422.description: You can't rely on souls anymore. It's over.

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003900_ZORAALJA
423.description: Don't think you've won yet. Oh no, far from it.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003910_ZORAALJA
424.description: Give the order to the fleet: raze Tuliyollal to the ground and harvest every last soul!

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003920_ZORAALJA
425.description: It is over─for Tuliyollal. Your works, your people─all will be ash before the day is done.

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003930_WUKLAMAT
426.description: Don't tell me you've forgotten? I'm not the only Dawnservant.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003960_KEMAKKA
429.description: Well come on then, you tin bastards!

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003970_YSHTOLA
430.description: If I didn't know better, I'd say you're enjoying yourself.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003980_KEMAKKA
431.description: I'm Hhetsarro. Nothing gets a hunter's blood pumping like a little danger.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_003990_YSHTOLA
432.description: Well now, it seems we have that in common. I haven't felt this alive in a good while.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004000_ZEKOWA
434.description: That's the spirit! We promised Vow Koana we'd deliver him a mountain of scrap─and I'm not about to let these hollow men make a liar out of me!

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004010_ESTINIEN
435.description: Hey, kid. The ones below are yours.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004060_THANCRED
443.description: Hardly sporting. And this despite our best efforts to thin the enemy ranks.

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004070_THANCRED
444.description: While it's not quite what we had planned, I'm glad we chose to remain in Tural.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004080_URIANGER
445.description: As am I. 'Twas an unexpected but welcome opportunity to join in the defense of this realm.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004090_THANCRED
446.description: And to his credit, Koana did ask very nicely. Still, it's a pity his brother had to delay our pleasure jaunt. But business always comes first.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004100_HOOBIGOMALESOLDIER
447.description: Damn it! Come no closer, you bastards!

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004120_BAKOOLJAJA
451.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)That was a near thing. Are you all right?

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004140_BAKOOLJAJA
453.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Saved your life? Yes, I know. Don't squander it!

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004150_HOOBIGOMALESOLDIER
454.description: I never thought you of all people would come to my rescue, Bakool Ja Ja. Thank you.

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004160_BAKOOLJAJA
456.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Still rings odd in my ears, the “thank you”s...

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004170_BAKOOLJAJA
457.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)But I could get used to it.

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004190_BAKOOLJAJA
459.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Right, we're not done yet!

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004200_KETENRAMM
465.description: We're holdin' our own against their infantry, but what of that monstrosity and its escort?

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004210_KETENRAMM
466.description: If they start bombardin' us with cannon fire, we'll have no means of fightin' back!

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004220_ALPHINAUD
467.description: Worry not, we have a countermeasure.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004240_KETENRAMM
469.description: What in the Navigator's name is it doin' here?

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004250_ALPHINAUD
470.description: Tuliyollal has entered into an alliance with Radz-at-Han. A wise and timely decision on Vow Koana's part.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004260_KOANA
471.description: Right in the nick... Tuliyollal shall never forget this debt.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004271_KOANA
473.description: So keep your eyes forward and do what only you can do.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004280_KOANA
474.description: Finish this, and return home─safe and sound.

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004290_ALEXANDRIASOLDIER
475.description: Report from the fleet. The enemy has offered unexpected resistance. We've been forced to withdraw.

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004350_SPHENE
482.description: You swore you wouldn't harm my people!

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004390_ZORAALJA
486.description: When the army fails in its duty, it is the charge of the King of Resolve to clean up its mess.

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004400_ZORAALJA
487.description: To achieve victory by any means necessary.

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004410_ZORAALJA
488.description: Zoraal Ja to Everkeep. Initiate Code Blood.

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004420_ZORAALJA
489.description: Execute all civilians and commandeer their souls!

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004470_WUKLAMAT
494.description: Gulool Ja! I told you not to come!

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004490_OTIS
496.description: You must flee, Gulool Ja! It isn't safe!

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004500_GULOOLJA
497.description: I'm not going anywhere! I have to stop my father!

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004540_ALISAIE
501.description: Using a child as a shield!? Have you no shame!?

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004550_OTIS
502.description: Release him at once, or you shall answer to me!

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004560_ZORAALJA
503.description: Pitiful relic. Kneel before your king!

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004580_ZORAALJA
505.description: Find me at the top of Everkeep.

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004590_ZORAALJA
506.description: There we will determine who is fit to rule.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004620_ZORAALJA
509.description: I have no more use for you. Begone.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004640_GULOOLJA
511.description: Otis... Lamaty'i... You have to stop him... You have to...

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004660_WUKLAMAT
513.description: Sphene! Can't you order them to stand down!?

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004670_SPHENE
514.description: The King of Resolve holds military authority. I cannot overrule his commands.

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004680_WUKLAMAT
515.description: If there's something you <hex:021A020203>can<hex:021A020103> do, then do it!

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004690_WUKLAMAT
516.description: Your crimes are beyond forgiveness, but your people are innocent.

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
519.description: If you care for your people, then protect them.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
520.description: We won't let Zoraal Ja have his way any longer!

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A5_000_003_NONE_VOICE
521.description: Hope you don't mind if I obliterate your army.

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004710_SPHENE
523.description: I deceived you all, and still...

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004720_ALISAIE
524.description: The talk can wait. When you said that you wanted to protect your people, I trust you weren't lying?

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004730_SPHENE
525.description: Of course not! There's nothing I wouldn't do for them!

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004740_WUKLAMAT
526.description: Then let's split up and get to work!

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004760_WUKLAMAT
528.description: Looks like that does it for this area.

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004770_SPHENE
529.description: Look─the king's forces are on the move!

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004780_SPHENE
530.description: There are still civilians on True Vue!

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004790_ALISAIE
531.description: Well, we can't leave the wounded. Let's divide into two groups.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004800_ALISAIE
532.description: Krile, Raha─please stay here and render aid.

533.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004810_ALISAIE
533.description: The rest of us will go and deal with the machines!

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004830_WUKLAMAT
535.description: Otis! You've got to wake up!

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004860_WUKLAMAT
538.description: It should be safe to approach.

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004880_SPHENE
540.description: I remember you, Otis. So please, remember yourself.

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004890_SPHENE
541.description: You're a proud knight of Alexandria. A man who lives to serve the kingdom and its subjects!

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004920_OTIS
544.description: I am Ser Otis Velona, lord captain of the royal knights of Alexandria!

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004930_OTIS
545.description: Upon mine honor, you shall harm neither my fair queen nor our citizens!

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004950_WUKLAMAT
547.description: Thank you, Lord Captain. For the delicious repast. For everything.

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004960_SPHENE
548.description: The old units do not have regulators. Their souls cannot be recovered.

549.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004970_SPHENE
549.description: He is gone... The Otis who so valiantly fought for us...

550.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004980_SPHENE
550.description: I'm truly grateful for your help. Would that I had the time to thank you properly...

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004990_SPHENE
551.description: But I'm afraid I cannot linger.

552.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_004995_SPHENE
552.description: There are urgent duties I must perform.

556.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005030_GEODE
556.description: So he's the one who was looking after Gulool Ja...

557.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005040_CAHCIUA
557.description: Thanks to you, Solution Nine has been spared the worst, but the situation on the other levels is grim.

558.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005050_CAHCIUA
558.description: We're currently assessing the full extent of the casualties. In the meantime, could you help us treat the wounded?

559.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005060_WUKLAMAT
559.description: Are you all right, Gulool Ja?

560.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005070_GULOOLJA
560.description: Lots of people are dead because of my father, aren't they?

562.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005090_GULOOLJA
562.description: And Otis... He's gone too, isn't he?

564.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005110_GULOOLJA
564.description: My father is a bad man. That's why you're going to kill him, aren't you?

569.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005160_WUKLAMAT
569.description: You're right. We're going to confront your father.

570.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005170_WUKLAMAT
570.description: He invaded Tuliyollal and hurt my people. As Vow of Resolve, it's my duty to bring him to justice.

571.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005180_GULOOLJA
571.description: Don't you think of him as family anymore?

572.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005190_WUKLAMAT
572.description: After the attack, I was filled with rage. I told myself over and over that he's no brother of mine.

573.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005200_WUKLAMAT
573.description: But it isn't so simple. No matter what I feel or say, all those years I spent striving to live up to his example... They won't just disappear.

574.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005210_WUKLAMAT
574.description: What's more, it's <hex:021A020203>because<hex:021A020103> we're family that we have to correct each other when someone goes astray.

575.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005220_WUKLAMAT
575.description: That's why I must confront my brother. Like your grandfather did, even though it cost him his life.

577.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005240_GULOOLJA
577.description: If my father was gone too...

579.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005260_CAHCIUA
579.description: What are you saying, Gulool Ja? Take a look around.

581.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005280_WUKLAMAT
581.description: You have us, Gulool Ja─<hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> of us. We'll be with you, through thick and thin.

582.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005290_WUKLAMAT
582.description: You're not alone. You'll never be alone again.

585.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005320_CAHCIUA
585.description: Shale, can you see to the lock?

588.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005350_SHALE
588.description: (-Shale-)Follow the passage inside and you'll come to an elevator. It'll take you to the eleventh level.

590.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005370_KRILE
590.description: The eleventh level, just below the summit...

591.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005380_CAHCIUA
591.description: Look─soul cells. This is where they're kept.

593.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005400_CAHCIUA
593.description: Indeed. Many died in the attack. Their souls would have been processed and transported here for storage.

595.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005420_ALISAIE
595.description: A soul cell is supposed to light up green when loaded, isn't it?

596.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005430_ALISAIE
596.description: Yet the light is out on most of these...

598.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005440_WUKLAMAT
598.description: Don't tell me he's already used them up!?

599.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005450_WUKLAMAT
599.description: That's why he cut down one of his own─for the regulator!

601.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005470_ALISAIE
601.description: Alphinaud? And Y'shtola and Estinien too!

602.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005480_ALPHINAUD
602.description: Lest you wonder, all is well in Tural. The enemy has withdrawn, freeing us up to come and lend you a hand.

603.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005481_ESTINIEN
603.description: The Backroom crew gave us a briefing. No rest for the righteous as usual, eh?

604.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005490_YSHTOLA
604.description: The idea of empowering oneself with souls is rather reminiscent of voidsent practices. I should be keen to learn more about the process─after more pressing matters have been resolved.

607.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005501_ALISAIE
607.description: I believe I speak for everyone when I say I'm glad you're here.

608.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005510_ALISAIE
608.description: As you'll have heard, the Alexandrians have suffered heavy casualties. We must stop Zoraal Ja before it gets any worse.

611.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
611.description: With comrades of such caliber, we've nothing to fear.

612.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005520_WUKLAMAT
612.description: I thank you for coming with me this far, my friends. And I ask you to lend me your strength one last time.

613.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005530_WUKLAMAT
613.description: Together, let us defeat Zoraal Ja and safeguard the future of Tuliyollal!

614.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005540_CAHCIUA
614.description: And here is where I must excuse myself. Come back in one piece, you hear me?

615.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005550_WUKLAMAT
615.description: We will! Every one of us!

616.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005560_WUKLAMAT
616.description: What in the world is that?

619.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005590_ESTINIEN
619.description: Aye... It dwarfs even the one Zeromus opened.

620.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005600_YSHTOLA
620.description: That is no voidgate. It doesn't lead to the Thirteenth.

622.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005620_YSHTOLA
622.description: Yes. In all likelihood, it's a portal to yet another reflection.

623.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005630_GRAHATIA
623.description: By the Twelve... To think that realities being fused together was only the beginning...

624.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005640_YSHTOLA
624.description: The speculation must wait. He's here.

625.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005650_YSHTOLA
625.description: There is a limit to how much aether a living being can harbor while retaining its physical form.

626.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005660_YSHTOLA
626.description: Zoraal Ja has far exceeded that limit.

627.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005670_YSHTOLA
627.description: With the souls he has absorbed, he has attained power to rival even a king among voidsent, but at a terrible cost...

631.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005710_ZORAALJA
631.description: How it vexes...when you call me Brother...

632.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005720_ZORAALJA
632.description: Brother... Blood heir... Resilient Son... Who am I? What is my path? Why was I born?

633.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005730_WUKLAMAT
633.description: I am Wuk Lamat, Vow of Resolve of Tuliyollal.

634.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005731_WUKLAMAT
634.description: And you are Zoraal Ja, King of Resolve of Alexandria.

635.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005732_WUKLAMAT
635.description: For the last time we fight. For duty, for blood─for everything!

637.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005750_ZORAALJA
637.description: Hold nothing back. This multitude of souls I shall burn to the last mote.

638.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005760_ZORAALJA
638.description: I will kill you and prove the miracle! I will prove that I am Father's true successor!

639.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005770_ZORAALJA
639.description: Come at me with your all. I will make you kneel.

646.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005840_GULOOLJA
646.description: Because I don't understand why it had to be this way. Why don't I know you?

648.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005860_ZORAALJA
648.description: How could I be a father...when my own spurned me?

649.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005870_ZORAALJA
649.description: He left me nothing. No throne. No legacy. Nothing. And so I had nothing to leave you.

653.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005884_ZORAALJA
653.description: You ask a lost man for the way...

654.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005885_ZORAALJA
654.description: I do not presume to call you mine...nor do I desire anything of you.

655.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005880_ZORAALJA
655.description: But I leave behind that which I've gained by the sweat of my brow... It is yours to embrace...or spurn...

657.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005900_ZORAALJA
657.description: I walked a path of ruin...

661.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005921_ZORAALJA
661.description: For the Resilient Son... The miracle...

662.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005930_WUKLAMAT
662.description: You think Papa left you nothing?

663.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005940_WUKLAMAT
663.description: You godsdamned fool! You have the one thing he couldn't leave anyone else! You and Gulool Ja!

666.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_005970_WUKLAMAT
666.description: Zoraal Ja is gone. There's no need to fight anymore.

669.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006000_SPHENE
669.description: I wanted to express my gratitude to you all. For vanquishing the King of Resolve and delivering my people.

670.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006010_SPHENE
670.description: And to express my regret for what I've done to yours.

671.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006020_WUKLAMAT
671.description: Your apologies won't bring back our dead or lessen your guilt.

672.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006030_WUKLAMAT
672.description: Still, to strike you down in revenge would trigger all-out war between our nations. More innocents would suffer.

673.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006040_WUKLAMAT
673.description: Even if we cannot be friends right now, we need to find a different path forward. A way that Tuliyollal and Alexandria can coexist.

674.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006050_SPHENE
674.description: I fear that can never be.

676.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006070_SPHENE
676.description: There is no other path for us. It's too late.

677.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006080_SPHENE
677.description: I cooperated with Zoraal Ja because I needed the life force yielded by the slain to sustain the Endless.

678.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006090_SPHENE
678.description: Of course, the king betrayed me, and with his army defeated, that plan can no longer be realized.

679.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006100_SPHENE
679.description: But I can't─I won't─fail my people. Be they possessed of flesh or no, all of them are dear to me.

680.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006110_SPHENE
680.description: If there is something I can do for them, as their queen, I must do it!

681.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006120_ALISAIE
681.description: Hear me, Sphene. We appreciate your commitment to serving the Alexandrians and have endeavored to understand your beliefs.

682.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006130_ALISAIE
682.description: Be that as it may, you <hex:021A020203>must<hex:021A020103> know it's wrong to sacrifice our living to save your dead!

683.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006140_SPHENE
683.description: I see. It's because you do not know them that you believe they're dead.

684.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006150_SPHENE
684.description: They're not. So long as they are remembered, they shall never die.

686.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006170_SPHENE
686.description: No matter what anyone may say, I refuse to believe that Cahciua's is a hollow existence. That she can simply be allowed to fade away!

689.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006200_SPHENE
689.description: ...am the bearer of the memories of Queen Sphene of Alexandria, and my desire to protect my people transcends all others!

690.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006210_SPHENE
690.description: For them, I will do anything! No price is too high!

694.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006240_SPHENE
694.description: There exists a legend in Alexandria. In ages past, faced with a calamity in their world, a clan of people used a singular power to flee to ours.

695.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006250_SPHENE
695.description: The key which manifests this power answers to fervent desires. Desperate, all-consuming supplications that have given rise to many a miracle.

696.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006260_SPHENE
696.description: That key holds the secret to interdimensional fusion, and unraveling its mysteries was the foremost mission of the scientists of Preservation.

697.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006270_SPHENE
697.description: Alas, they failed to fully grasp its workings, leaving us with only partial control over it.

698.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006280_SPHENE
698.description: Nevertheless, if I'm to sustain the inhabitants of Living Memory, I have no choice but to call upon its power.

700.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006300_SPHENE
700.description: For hundreds of years I tried, but it was all to no avail.

701.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006301_SPHENE
701.description: My benevolence did naught to protect my realm...

702.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006310_SPHENE
702.description: But I can still take up arms and fight.

703.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07004_006320_SPHENE
703.description: If bloodshed will save my subjects, then I will become history's most brutal queen.
